# Schematic review: Sunbeam EM7000 main controller board

This record holds every round of the schematic review of `main-board.kicad_sch`, as `docs/board-design-method.md` (section "Schematic review") requires.

## Round 1

- **Schematic judged**: git commit 93edc2150f55882a9e8552c16e66f945e4f87723 (hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board/main-board.kicad_sch and its sheets; the only uncommitted file in the tree is the untracked main-board.kicad_prl).
- **Netlist**: `/Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/kicad-cli sch export netlist --output /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-david-repos-coffee/bbdbdd7d-2b79-4b88-9553-2a2bcf63188a/scratchpad/sch-review-r1/review.net hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board/main-board.kicad_sch` (KiCad 10.0.7; 430 parts, 275 nets, 18 sheets; kicad-cli printed "Warning: schematic has annotation errors").
- **Records read**: hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board/circuit-proof.md, circuit-verdicts.md, bring-up-provision.md, open-items.md, schematic-spec.yaml, sheets/*.yaml (as cross-checks), controller-pin-table.md; docs/sunbeam-em7000/controller-board-division.md (not read in full), connector-pinouts.md, controller-board-design-constraints.md (leakage, derating rows only); hardware/sunbeam-em7000/separation-basis.yaml (accepted_on 2026-10-23); drawings of all 18 sheets from `task hw:sheets` and ERC (159 violations: endpoint_off_grid 141, label_dangling 14, power_pin_not_driven 2, pin_to_pin 1, ground_pin_not_ground 1).
- **Datasheets opened this round** (curl and pdftotext): STM32H742/743 DS12110 Rev 10 (March 2023); AMC131M02 SBASA56 (September 2023); AP7361C DS37274 Rev 5-2 (October 2020); Mean Well IRM-20 specification (file IRM-20-SPEC 2025-11-21); Hongfa HF115F-Q 2024 Rev. 1.00; SN74HCT541 SCLS306E (May 2022); SN74LVC1G17 SCES351Y (October 2025); AO3400A Rev 3.1 (July 2023); AO3401A; HX711 Avia V2.0. **Not opened** (address returned 403, 429, a web page or no connection): MAX31865, MOC3052M, LTV-814S, NX3008NBK, 74AHCT1G17, BAT54 series, BAS116, BZX84, PESD5V0F1BL, USBLC6-2SC6, BTA204S-600B; no address was tried for the remaining parts (SMF6.0A, 1N4148WS, HF32FA-G, the fuses, 14D471K, the crystals, the headers and the passive series).
- **Reviewer**: one reviewer, a Claude Sonnet 5.5 session, working from the commit, the netlist, the drawings, the records above and the datasheets above; the fanned-out form was not used.

### Findings

| Finding | Raised by | Severity | What and where | Closed by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.1 | PINV-1 | function | The +5V rail (nets +5V, /Logic supply/+5V_MOD) can reach the module OVP threshold of 5.75 to 6.75 V (IRM-20 specification, over voltage row) while U302 pin 3 (AP7361C, DS37274 Rev 5-2) has an absolute maximum VIN of 6.5 V and a recommended maximum of 6.0 V; nothing on the sheet clamps +5V between U301 and U302 (Logic supply sheet: U301 pin 4, C301, C302, JP301, C303, U302 pin 3). On the USB position the record gives D402 VC 10.3 V at 19.4 A reaching the same pin (open-items.md, USB programming port). | |
| 1.2 | PINV-1 | function | Wall-board header J761 pins 5 and 6 (nets /MAINS_PRES_C, /MAINS_PRES_S) go straight to U401 PE15 pin 45 and PD7 pin 88 with no series resistor, clamp or pull, from a board with its own supply (+5V_WB through JP761). The level the wall board drives is declared in no record read, so the worst-case voltage into a pin limited to min(VDD,VDDA,VBAT)+4.0 V (DS12110 Table 21) is not bounded (Heater LED drive and wall board header sheet, Controller sheet). | |
| 1.3 | PINV-1 | function | A rating a reviewer cannot source counts as absent. HX711 (U630, U631) states no absolute maximum anywhere in its datasheet (Avia V2.0), and the datasheets of these parts could not be opened in this round (Nexperia, onsemi, Lite-On and Analog Devices addresses returned 403, 429 or no connection; no maker address was found for the others): 74AHCT1G17, LTV-814S-TA1-A, MAX31865ATP+, MOC3052M, NX3008NBK, BAS116, BAT54HT1G, BAT54S, BZX84-C12, PESD5V0F1BL, USBLC6-2SC6, SMF6.0A, 1N4148WS, HF32FA-G, BTA204S-600B (U201, U602, U620, U621, U701, U711, Q201, Q202, Z201, Z202, D201-D206, D401, D402, D501-D506, D520-D531, D570, D571, D731, D741, D821, K731, K741, T701, T711). Every net with a pin on one of them fails until the rating is read (affected nets listed in the verdict rows). | |
| 1.4 | PINV-2 | function | Nets driven from a separately supplied source with no isolating part or unpowered-tolerance statement: /MAINS_PRES_C and /MAINS_PRES_S from the wall board (+5V_WB, level undeclared), and /POL_OUT into U201 pin 2 (74AHCT1G17 on +5V, driven from the 3.3 V controller domain) where no table the record cites states the input current at VCC = 0 and there is no series resistor (R201 and R202 are 100 kohm pull-downs to GND; the record itself lists this as F2b in circuit-verdicts.md). | |
| 1.5 | PARTS-1 | function | Required external parts cannot be shown for: U201, U602, U620, U621, U701, U711 and D401 (datasheets not opened, see 1.3), and U401 whose crystal load networks (Y401 with C414 and C415, Y402 with C416 and C417) rest on crystal datasheets not opened here and, for the 32.768 kHz crystal, a C0 maximum the record says the maker does not state (circuit-proof.md, rows not met, B, LSE crystal load). | |
| 1.6 | PARTS-1 | function | U302 (AP7361C) output C304 is a polarised 47 uF part (CA45-B-10V-47uF-K), not a ceramic capacitor: DS37274 Rev 5-2 pin table and Application Information require at least 2.2 uF ceramic on OUT and state stability for ceramics only; no ceramic capacitor of 2.2 uF or more is on net /Logic supply/+3V3_REG or +3V3 (the 100 nF and 4.7 uF parts are decoupling on +3V3 behind the link JP302). | |
| 1.7 | CAPD-1 | function | No ceramic capacitor that sets a filter corner, a regulator or reference stability, a crystal load or a timing has bias, temperature and tolerance arithmetic from a maker curve: the record itself lists the curve as absent for C202, C204 (circuit-verdicts.md F15) and for the VCAP pair C412, C413 (circuit-proof.md, rows not met, B) whose tolerance stack alone is under the 2.2 uF -20 percent floor of DS12110 Table 25 note 2; the same holds for the other capacitors listed in the rows (C203, C205, C303, C414-C418, C501-C503, C520, C522-C524, C570, C571, C601-C608, C612, C630, C640, C645, C670, C672, C675, C677, C861-C863). | |
| 1.8 | BUSL-1 | function | No bus or open-drain line has both pull-up limits shown: the far-end figures (sensor VOL and IOL for STM_SCL/SDA and BREW_SCL/SDA, flow meter output type and low level for FLOW_RAW, the optocoupler U602 collector current and rise time at 22 kohm for ZC_IN, indicator forward voltage for KEY1-KEY5) are not in any datasheet or record read (circuit-proof.md rows not met, C flow input level and D key line sink current; E2.1); bus capacitance of the off-board runs is undeclared. | |
| 1.9 | STRAP-1 | function | Inputs held to no level when the connected board is absent: /MAINS_PRES_C and /MAINS_PRES_S (J761 pins 5 and 6, wall board not fitted) float into U401; the strap level of /PT1_CS and /PT2_CS (R641, R646 pull-ups to 3V3) rests on the MAX31865 datasheet, which could not be opened. | |
| 1.10 | STRAP-2 | function | The assignment of J401 (ARM Cortex Debug 10-pin) is not verified against a document: the record says the Arm document cited by the stock symbol (DDI0314H) could not be returned (open-items.md, Cortex Debug pinout source) and no probe connection guide is cited; DS12110 gives only the controller side (PA13 SWDIO, PA14 SWCLK, PB3 SWO). | |
| 1.11 | RCFL-1 | function | No converter filter has the sourced figures the item needs. For the STM32H743 inputs behind R502-R506 and C501-C503, R533 and C522, R536 and C523, R539 and C524, R573 and C570, R577 and C571 no record declares the sample rate, conversion time and signal band, and DS12110 states the sampling capacitor and Rain only as typical or formula values the record does not use (circuit-proof.md C, rows not met: thermistor accuracy; the converter maxima are typical only). HX711 states no input sampling capacitor or source resistance. The MAX31865 datasheet could not be opened for C640, C645. | |
| 1.12 | SUPPLY-1 | function | Inrush is not bounded by a sourced figure where it matters: /LINE feeds U301 whose cold-start inrush is 40 A typical at 230 Vac (IRM-20 specification) against F101, tabs and JP101 for which the pre-arcing I2t and tab rating are absent (circuit-proof.md A and B, inrush rows); /USB_VBUS_F and /Controller/USB_VBUS charge 84.3 uF behind F401 against the 10 uF USB 2.0 7.2.4.1 allows (open-items.md; accepted by the owner for bench use, not a sourced figure); the sensor 3.3 V feeds behind F520-F524 have no declared sensor capacitance. | |
| 1.13 | SUPPLY-2 | function | +3V3, +3V3A and +5V carry no supervisor or lockout threshold above the loads' minimum: the only reset hold is the controller's internal power-down reset, 1.71 V minimum on LQFP100 (DS12110, VDD note 4), while HX711 DVDD needs 2.6 V (Avia pin table) and AMC131M02 DVDD 3.0 V (SBASA56 6.4); U302 (DS37274) states no input undervoltage lockout threshold in the sections read. The rows give no threshold, hysteresis or dip arithmetic. | |
| 1.14 | POLAR-1 | function | Polarity cannot be shown against a datasheet for any polarised part: C302, C304, C792 (electrolytic or polymer) and every diode, zener and optocoupler LED (list in rows) have datasheets not opened in this round (see 1.3), so no reverse-voltage rating is cited. Orientation as drawn was checked against the netlist pin numbers only (flyback diodes D731, D741, D821 cathode on +5V; BAT54S common on the signal; zener cathode pin 3 on POL_COIL_LO). | |
| 1.15 | FAULT-1 | safety | K201 contact welded or failed closed is neither safe nor detected on the board: the contact is the only element between LINE and LINE1 (nets /LINE, /LINE1), there is no auxiliary or mirror contact and no net senses LINE1 downstream of K201 pin 14 (net /LINE1 holds only J101, K201 pin 14, TP104), the AMC131M02 channels measure LINE-NEUTRAL upstream and the neutral shunt current, and the mains-presence confirm inputs (J761 pins 5, 6) have no circuit on this board. The record also carries three residuals as accepted (coil low end shorted, buffer oscillation, zener short above 1.10 H: circuit-verdicts.md A, F1), and the time-out and removal-time rows are NO (circuit-proof.md A). | |
| 1.16 | BARRIER-1 | safety | No barrier part carries a sourced rating at or above the declared reinforced insulation (10.0 mm creepage, 3.0 mm clearance, 4.0 kV impulse, separation-basis.yaml): AMC131M02 U601 creepage and clearance 8.0 mm, pollution degree 2 (SBASA56 7.x insulation table) against pollution degree 3 and 10.0 mm; K201 HF115F-Q creepage only "over 8 mm" with clearance and working isolation voltage not stated (2024 Rev. 1.00); IRM-20-5 U301 creepage not stated in the specification read; U602, U701, U711, K731, K741 datasheets not opened. The barriers of K201 (interlock relay) and U601 (voltage and current measurement) are not in the basis list (supply-module, heater-switch, pump-drive, supply-timing-front-end, mains-presence-confirm, valve-switch, pressure-sensor-water-path). | |
| 1.17 | SURGE-1 | safety | RV101 (14D471K) has no sourced surge rating: its datasheet was not opened here, the record states the surge source impedance, clamp voltage at the surge current and the standard waveform are open (circuit-verdicts.md F12, circuit-proof.md A, surge clamp), so continuous voltage, peak current, energy and clamp are absent; the separation basis gives overvoltage category II but no surge test row. | |
| 1.18 | ESD-1 | function | No declared discharge level for any reachable connector or control (open-items.md and circuit-verdicts.md F17: the signed basis lists the USB connector as touchable and declares no level), so the clamping arithmetic against each pin behind it cannot be shown; J401, J402, J501-J503, J520-J525, J570, J571, J620, J625, J630, J635, J761, J791, J821, J861, J862 and the tabs J101-J110 and SW401 are listed; the sensor and probe connectors J620, J625, J630, J635, J761, J791, J821, J861, J862 carry no clamp at all. | |
| 1.19 | TOUCH-1 | safety | U301 passes a leakage of under 0.25 mA at 277 Vac across its own barrier to a secondary the separation basis lists as touchable (USB connector, controls, enclosure); no record read names the governing standard or the limit for the protection class (constraints record: "Leakage current: Set aside: no requirement or decision fixes a figure") and no estimate at the top of the span and the highest frequency is recorded. | |
| 1.20 | EMSRC-1 | quality | The only filter at the inlet is C101, a 100 nF X2 across LINE and NEUTRAL, with no line-to-earth capacitance and no choke; no record read names the emission limit or the attenuation required (circuit-verdicts.md: "the limits are not held, emission is open"), and the filter maker's rating of C101 (MPX104K31C3KN15600) could not be sourced here. | |
| 1.21 | EMSRC-2 | quality | T701 and T711 (BTA204S-600B) switch inductive pump loads with no snubber or other network across them (Pump drives sheet: MT2 to MT1 carries only the fuse and the gate path), and no datasheet statement that none is needed could be shown (the datasheet address returned a web page, not the document). | |
| 1.22 | EMSRC-3 | quality | No record states the edge rate chosen for any switching part, the emission limit it serves or the loss at that edge: U301 (bought module), U791 outputs behind R791-R795, the MOSFET drivers Q701, Q711, Q731, Q741, Q761, Q771, Q821-Q824 behind their 100 ohm gate resistors, and the triacs T701, T711; the EMC record cited by the item was not read. | |

| 1.24 | DERATE-2 | quality | No part can be held to a derated rating while DERATE-1 gives no factor; circuit-proof.md states stresses against absolute maxima only. Every part listed fails until the policy exists; test points carry no rated stress and pass. | |

### Owner decisions of 2026-10-29, judged on their merits

- **Relay weld and startup confirmation (finding 1.15, now 2.16)**: REQ-ACTUATION-CONFIRMATION-001.C6 requires a confirmation after power-on, from an independent observation, that outputs respond and that an output commanded off draws nothing. That is a requirement the machine serves, but it is carried out by the controller and its firmware, and `FAULT-1` says detection is by the chain's own means and never by the controller or its firmware. It therefore does not make the item met, does not conflict with it (so `overridden by:` is not shown), and does not apply to this board in some other way. The owed one-shot thermal cutoff (DEL-BENCH-SAFETY-CHAIN-INSPECTION, DEL-HW-BRING-UP.C4) is not on the schematic. The finding is of safety severity, so it closes only by a change to the schematic or by a named person's acceptance of a reason recorded with `accepted_by` and `accepted_on`; it stays open.
- **Pump snubbers and module inrush limiter provisioned, not fitted**: the schematic now carries the positions (R706 C701, R716 C711, TP702, TP712, JP303, RT301) and the bring-up measurements decide whether to fit them. Step 5 allows a change, or a reason that the item is met, does not apply, or is overridden; a decision to measure later is none of them, and `EMSRC-2` and `SUPPLY-1` ask for the network or a sourced limited current on the schematic as it is. The findings stay open (2.11, 2.13, 2.22); the provision also adds two new rows of `SUPPLY-1` for the unfitted snubber nets, whose resistor pulse rating is unstated.
- **USB static level 4**: the owner has declared IEC 61000-4-2 level 4 (8 kV contact, 15 kV air) and USBLC6-2 DS4260 Rev 7 meets it, so the part of 1.18 that found no declared level for J402 is met. The clamping arithmetic that `ESD-1` and `PINV-1` also ask for is not: 17 V at 5 A against a 6 V pin limit with no pulse figure (2.2). J402 still fails, and the other connectors still have no level.

### Findings

| Finding | Raised by | Severity | What and where | Closed by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2.1 | PINV-1 | function | Cable position of JP301 and the +5V rail: with D402 only ahead of it (the ideal diode was dropped), a plug-in surge up to D402's clamp (10.3 V at 19.4 A, SMF6.0A) and the 10.5 V undamped step reach U201 and U791, whose absolute maximum is 7.0 V (74AHCT1G17 Rev. 5 Table 5, SCLS306E), and the coils of K201 (7.5 V short period) and K731 and K741 (8.5 V); at the module's own trip (6.75 V) U201 and U791 keep 0.25 V. The LT1963A change closes round 1 finding 1.1 for U302 itself (20 V). Net +5V; sheets Logic supply, Interlock, Valve drives, Gauge drive. Continues 1.1. | |
| 2.2 | PINV-1 | function | USB_DM and USB_DP: the clamp D401 lets 17 V through at 5 A (DS4260 Rev 7 Table 2, 8/20 us), about 23 V at 24 A, to PA11 and PA12, whose limit is 6 V (4.0 V with VDD absent) with no pulse withstand stated (DS12110 Rev 11 Table 109); the owner's level 4 is declared but the residue is not bounded by the controller's datasheet (circuit-proof.md, open-items.md). Controller sheet. Continues 1.18. | |
| 2.3 | PINV-1 | function | Ratings that cannot be sourced still count as absent: HX711 (U630, U631) states no absolute maximum (Avia V2.0); BTA204S-600B (T701, T711) could not be opened at any route (the LCSC links give BTA204S-600D and BTA208S-800B); 1N4148WS (D731, D741, D821) could not be opened at any route. Nets with a pin on them fail. Continues 1.3. | |
| 2.4 | PINV-1 | function | K731 and K741 (HF32FA-G, 2026 Rev. 1.00) state a maximum switching voltage of 250 VAC; the valve nets /COFVALVE, /HOTVALVE and /Valve drives/VALVE_COM carry up to 253 V rms (358 V peak) at the top of the declared span (separation-basis.yaml working_voltage). Valve drives sheet. New. | |
| 2.5 | PINV-2 | function | /POL_OUT from U401 PC7 (3.3 V domain) goes straight to U201 pin 2 (74AHCT1G17 on +5V): the datasheet states no input tolerance or current at VCC = 0 V, no series resistor is present (R201 and R202 are pull-downs). Interlock sheet. Continues 1.4 (the wall-board half, /MAINS_PRES_C and /MAINS_PRES_S, is closed by the divider). | |
| 2.6 | PARTS-1 | function | U401: the crystal load networks (Y401 with C414 and C415, Y402 with C416 and C417) rest on no crystal datasheet: the YXC X50328MSB2GI and Seiko Epson Q13FC13500004 sheets could not be opened, and the 32.768 kHz crystal's C0 maximum is not stated (circuit-proof.md B LSE row). Continues 1.5; the other round 1 parts (U201, U602, U620, U621, U701, U711, D401, U302) now pass. | |
| 2.7 | CAPD-1 | function | The ceramics that set a filter, a stability or a reference have no bias, temperature and tolerance arithmetic from a maker curve for the part number: C202 to C205, C303, C412 to C418, C501 to C503, C520 to C524, C570, C571, C601 to C608, C612, C630, C640, C645, C670, C672, C675, C677, C861 to C863 (VCAP pair C412 C413: 2.2 uF with tolerance alone under the 2.2 uF -20 % floor of DS12110). C304 and C305 are closed (maker curve, 16.8 uF effective against 10 uF). Continues 1.7. | |
| 2.8 | BUSL-1 | function | Open-drain and bus lines still lack both pull-up limits: the far-end VOL and IOL for STM_SCL/SDA and BREW_SCL/SDA, the flow meter's output type and low level, U602's collector current and rise time at 22 kohm for ZC_IN, the indicator forward voltage for KEY1 to KEY5, and the off-board bus capacitance are in no record. /NRST (new U402) passes. Continues 1.8. | |
| 2.9 | STRAP-2 | function | J401's assignment is verified against no document: the Arm document the symbol cites could not be returned in this round (infocenter.arm.com address and a web.archive.org copy), and no probe connection guide is cited. Continues 1.10. | |
| 2.10 | RCFL-1 | function | No converter filter has the sourced figures the item needs: the STM32 inputs behind R502 to R506 and C501 to C503, R533 and C522, R536 and C523, R539 and C524, R573 and C570, R577 and C571 have no declared sample rate, conversion time or signal band; HX711 states no sampling capacitor or source resistance; MAX31865 gives its own 10 nF figure for a 1 kohm RTD but no signal band is declared for the probes (C640, C645). Continues 1.11. | |
| 2.11 | SUPPLY-1 | function | /LINE and /Logic supply/LINE_MOD: the module's cold-start inrush is 40 A typical at 230 Vac with no maximum or duration (IRM-20), F101's pre-arcing I2t and the tab rating are absent, and the limiter RT301 is drawn but not fitted (JP303 link in place), so the schematic as it stands carries the unlimited current; a decision to measure at bring-up is not a step 5 reason. Continues 1.12. | |
| 2.12 | SUPPLY-1 | function | USB_VBUS_F, /Controller/USB_VBUS and +5V: 81.3 uF behind F401 in the cable position against the 10 uF USB 2.0 7.2.4.1 allows without surge limiting; the owner accepted it for bench use, which is not one of the step 5 closing forms. Continues 1.12. | |
| 2.13 | SUPPLY-1 | function | The sensor 3.3 V feeds behind F520 to F524 have no declared sensor capacitance (continues 1.12), and the unfitted snubber positions /Pump drives/PUMP_C_SNUB and PUMP_S_SNUB charge C701 and C711 through R706 and R716 at 3.6 A and 6.4 mJ with no pulse rating for the 2512 resistor and no I2t for F701 and F711 (new). | |
| 2.14 | SUPPLY-2 | function | U402 (TLV803S) gives +3V3 and +3V3A a hold, but its lowest threshold 2.87 V is under AMC131M02 DVDD 3.0 V, MAX31865 VDD and the oscillator's 2.97 V, and no load-step dip arithmetic is given against the 40 mV hysteresis; +5V has no supervisor or lockout for U201, U791 or the K201 coil. Narrows 1.13. | |
| 2.15 | POLAR-1 | function | C302 (MVK) and C792 are aluminium electrolytics whose sheets reached through the LCSC pages state no reverse-voltage rating; D731, D741 and D821 are 1N4148WS whose datasheet could not be opened (see 2.3). The other diodes, zeners, clamps and optocouplers of round 1 now cite a sheet and pass. C304 is a ceramic and no longer selected. Continues 1.14. | |
| 2.16 | FAULT-1 | safety | K201 welded or failed closed is neither safe nor detected on the board: its contact is the only element between LINE and LINE1, no net senses LINE1 downstream of K201 pin 14, and the three residuals of circuit-verdicts.md A and F1 are accepted. The owner's startup confirmation (REQ-ACTUATION-CONFIRMATION-001.C6) and the owed one-shot thermal cutoff (DEL-BENCH-SAFETY-CHAIN-INSPECTION, DEL-HW-BRING-UP.C4) are not on the schematic: the confirmation runs in the controller and its firmware, on which the item says detection must not depend, and the cutoff is not drawn. Continues 1.15. | |
| 2.17 | BARRIER-1 | safety | No barrier part shows a sourced rating at or above the declared reinforced insulation (10.0 mm creepage, 3.0 mm clearance, 4.0 kV impulse): MOC3052M external creepage and clearance at least 7 mm; HF32FA-G and HF115F-Q over 8 mm; AMC131M02 8.0 mm at pollution degree 2; IRM-20 and LTV-814S state none; K201 and U601 are not in the basis list. Continues 1.16. | |
| 2.18 | SURGE-1 | safety | RV101 (14D471K) now has a maker sheet (300 Vac, 148 J, 775 V at 50 A, 4500 A), but the surge the place sees (test voltage, waveform, source impedance) is in no record, so the margin and the clamp against the barrier parts cannot be shown. Continues 1.17. | |
| 2.19 | ESD-1 | function | Level 4 is declared for the USB connector only; the clamp residue at PA11 and PA12 is unbounded (2.2), and no level is declared for J401, J501 to J503, J520 to J525, J570, J571, J620, J625, J630, J635, J761, J791, J821, J861, J862 or the tabs and SW401; the sensor and probe connectors carry no clamp. Continues 1.18. | |
| 2.20 | TOUCH-1 | safety | U301 leaks under 0.25 mA at 277 Vac to a secondary the separation basis lists as touchable; no record names the standard or limit for the protection class and no estimate is recorded. Continues 1.19. | |
| 2.21 | EMSRC-1 | quality | The only inlet filter is C101, a 100 nF X2 across LINE and NEUTRAL, with no line-to-earth capacitance, no choke, no named emission limit and no maker rating for this exact part number. Continues 1.20. | |
| 2.22 | EMSRC-2 | quality | T701 and T711 carry no fitted network; the unfitted positions R706 C701 and R716 C711 are not a network on the board, and the BTA204S-600B datasheet that could show none is needed could not be opened. Not fitting by owner decision is not a step 5 form. Continues 1.21. | |
| 2.23 | EMSRC-3 | quality | No record states the edge rate chosen for any switching part, the emission limit it serves or the loss at that edge (U301, U791 outputs, Q701, Q711, Q731, Q741, Q761, Q771, Q821 to Q824, T701, T711). Continues 1.22. | |
| 2.24 | DERATE-1 | quality | No derating policy is declared; schematic-spec.yaml holds a proposal only. Continues 1.23. | |
| 2.25 | DERATE-2 | quality | No part can be held to a derated rating while DERATE-1 fails; test points carry no rated stress and pass. Continues 1.24. | |
| 2.26 | DRAW-1 | cosmetic | Root sheet main-board: sheet symbols run past the page border, the symbol of In-stream temperature converters lies over the Controller symbol and pin labels of Valve drives and Gauge drive overprint; the root sheet is unchanged since round 1. Continues 1.25. | |
| 2.27 | DRAW-1 | cosmetic | Mains entry and load feed: nine hierarchical labels are wired to nothing because the nets inside are carried by global labels; unchanged since round 1. Continues 1.26. | |
| 2.28 | DRAW-1 | cosmetic | Pins of one circuit are joined by labels instead of short wires on Mains entry and load feed, Controller, Interlock, Pump drives and Supply voltage and current measurement; unchanged except for added parts on Pump drives and Logic supply. Continues 1.27. | |
| 2.29 | DRAW-1 | cosmetic | Text overlaps text, symbols or wires on the sheets round 1 listed that are unchanged, and now on the redrawn Logic supply (U302 text over +3V3_REG, U301 pin text over the LINE labels), Controller (U402 and C422 near the NRST label), Pump drives (R706 and R716 over the SNUB labels, TP702 and TP712 over F701 and F711), Heater LED drive and wall board header (GND flags over J761 pins 5 and 6) and In-stream temperature converters (PT1_FORCEN_SRC over R690, J628 over the title block). Continues 1.28. | |
| 2.30 | free pass | cosmetic | kicad-cli again prints "Warning: schematic has annotation errors"; no duplicate reference is in the netlist (445 unique references) and the cause was not located (power symbol references on 102-interlock repeat as #PWR01 and so on per sheet instance). Continues 1.30. | |
| 2.31 | free pass | cosmetic | Test point values differ from the net they probe: TP206 (TP_COIL_HI on +5V), TP671 (TP_WT1_INAP on WT1_INA_P) and TP673 (TP_WT2_INAP on WT2_INA_P). The round 1 finding 1.29 sweep fixed TP690 and TP691 only; these three were not searched for. | |

## Round 3

- **Schematic judged**: git commit 38c510a7fb2715fff36280618838e64d83cec2cd (hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board/main-board.kicad_sch and its sheets; the only uncommitted file in the tree is the untracked main-board.kicad_prl).
- **Netlist**: `/Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/kicad-cli sch export netlist --output /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-david-repos-coffee/bbdbdd7d-2b79-4b88-9553-2a2bcf63188a/scratchpad/sch-review-r3/review.net hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board/main-board.kicad_sch` (KiCad 10.0.7; 445 parts, 280 nets, 18 sheets; kicad-cli again printed "Warning: schematic has annotation errors"). Against round 2 the netlist is identical in parts, values, footprints, nets and every pin: what changed since commit b626ac66 is the hidden Rating field on every symbol, the design records and the recorded owner acceptances, not the circuit. The 18 sheet drawings from `task hw:sheets` (KICAD_CLI set) are byte-identical to round 2's apart from the date stamp, so every sheet's drawing verdict is carried and re-confirmed by looking at the Logic supply, Interlock, Controller and Pump drives drawings.
- **Records read**: hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board/circuit-proof.md (with circuit-proof/b_regulator_thermal.log), circuit-verdicts.md, bring-up-provision.md, open-items.md (including "Owner risk acceptances (2026-10-29)"), schematic-spec.yaml, derating-policy.yaml, pin-limits.yaml, parts-specification.yaml, catalogue-extract.yaml, pin-allocation.yaml, controller-input-map.yaml, manufacturer-limits.yaml, controller-pin-table.md; hardware/sunbeam-em7000/separation-basis.yaml (accepted_on 2026-10-29); the pre-order check's report (`python3 hardware/tools/board_check.py --root . --kicad-cli ...`: the main board fails on layout and workmanship lines that belong to the layout leaf, and on the schematic-side lines this round uses: derated_voltage U301, pin_limit U201 pin 2 and U401 pin 64, parts_catalogue U701 and U711, parts_part 85 positions); the drawings above.

### Owner decisions and acceptances of 2026-10-29, judged on their merits

The method's step 5 closes a finding by a change, or by a recorded reason written `met:`, `does not apply:` or `overridden by:` (for a safety finding with a named person's `accepted_by` and `accepted_on` in this record). "Never a judgement that the finding is unimportant." Each acceptance in open-items.md is read against that:

- **(a) K201 welding shut** (finding 3.15, safety). The reason, a weld is bounded by an independent element (series thermostats now, a one-shot non-restoring cutoff owed before mains, DEL-BENCH-SAFETY-CHAIN-INSPECTION and DEL-HW-BRING-UP.C4), is not `met:` because FAULT-1 requires the safe state or the detection to be shown from the schematic and the cutoff is not drawn or fitted; not `does not apply:`; and not `overridden by:` unless a requirement the board serves is named as making that element the protection. The firmware startup confirmation REQ-ACTUATION-CONFIRMATION-001.C6 is by the item's own words not detection. Open. What would close it: the cutoff drawn on this schematic (a change), or a Closed by of `overridden by:` naming the requirement, with accepted_by david and accepted_on in this record.
- **(b) cable-position surge against 7.0 V parts** (3.1, function). A failed buffer leaves the relay open and the cable position is a bench state with mains off: a consequence argument, none of the three forms. A lower-clamping part or a series resistor into U201 and U791 would be a change. Open.
- **(c) valve relays and (c2) 250 VAC fuses and U301 at 253 V** (3.4 and 3.23). 1 % over the maker's rating with firmware warning is acceptance of a shortfall. Open. Tool limit, not a finding: the derating rule has no exception mechanism and misreads divider voltage (maintenance solutions SOL-PRE-ORDER-CHECK-DERATED-VOLTAGE-ACROSS-DERIVED-NETS and SOL-PRE-ORDER-CHECK-PARTS-WITHOUT-CATALOGUE-NUMBER are authored); its per-part working voltages (for example 1.65 V on 5 V parts) are not relied on here and every DERATE-2 row carries its own arithmetic. The 12 pin_limit lines for GND pins ("driven from the domain logic") are likewise a tool misreading of a ground net and are not findings; the U201 pin 2 and U401 pin 64 lines are real (3.5). The catalogue number "none" for 98 positions (test points, links, wire) not being accepted by the catalogue rule is the known tool limit; the 85 symbols that do not carry the word are a real record-versus-schematic difference (3.32).
- **(d) snubbers R706 C701, R716 C711 and RT301 stay not fitted** (3.10, 3.12, 3.21). A decision that bring-up measures is not a form; the findings stay open. (They were carried as "provisioned, not fitted" in round 2 and nothing has changed.)
- **(e) bought-part creepage below 10.0 mm** (3.16, safety). Accepted at the maker's figure for U601 (8.0 mm), K201, K731, K741 (over 8 mm), U701, U711 (7 mm); the reasons (sealed enclosure, slots, planned coat, nothing touchable beyond the listed items) do not show the item met against the basis the owner signed, which stays at pollution degree 3 and 10.0 mm, and the coat would need a fresh basis. Not a form; the exceptions are also in a comment the board check does not read. Open. The part of 2.17 that said K201 and U601 are not in the basis list is closed by the re-signed basis (listed as interlock-relay and isolated-measurement).
- **Through-hole MOC3052M option declined**: the owner's choice stands as a design decision; it leaves 7 mm and the out-of-stock C8965 (3.31) in place.

### Judgements on what the owner and the records now offer

Step 5 allows a change, or a reason written `met:`, `does not apply:` or `overridden by:` a requirement the board serves or a catalogue item it must also meet; a safety finding closes by a reason only with a named person's `accepted_by` and `accepted_on`. The reviewer does not write Closed by; the texts below are what this round finds to be valid, for the designer to write.

**Is `overridden by: DEC-MAIN-BOARD-RESIDUAL-RISKS-ACCEPTED-BY-OWNER` a valid form?** Not by itself. A decision is neither a requirement nor a catalogue item, and a recorded acceptance of a shortfall is not a reason the item is met. It is valid only through a requirement it addresses that itself admits the outcome, and only for the risk that requirement covers. Per risk:

- **(a) K201 welding shut (3.15, safety): valid, in part.** REQ-SAFETY-CHAIN-001.C8 and DEL-HW-MAIN-BOARD-DESIGNED.C25 admit a fault whose hazard a named independent element still bounds; the decision names the series thermostats and the one-shot cutoff that DEL-HW-BRING-UP.C4 requires before mains; the person is named (decided_by david, 2026-10-29). Closed for K201 welded as `overridden by: REQ-SAFETY-CHAIN-001.C8 ...; accepted_by: david; accepted_on: 2026-10-29`. It reopens if the cutoff is not fitted before mains or the thermostats are found to reset (the decision's own condition). The decision does not name U201 oscillating, a Z201 or Z202 short above 1.10 H, or POL_COIL_LO shorted to ground, which circuit-proof.md A bounds by the same element: they stay open as 4.15 until decision (a) names them.
- **(b) cable-position surge (3.1): not valid.** None of the criteria the decision addresses allows a pin above its absolute maximum; the ground is a consequence argument. Open as 4.1.
- **(c), (c2) 250 V parts at 253 V (3.4, 3.23): not valid as written; one step from valid for the derating side.** The requirement that applies is SOL-HW-MAIN-BOARD-SCHEMATIC-PROVEN.C8 (where no catalogue part holds at the graded figure, record the revisit in the constraints record with its reason, and do not stretch the rating). The constraints record holds no such revisit, so C8 is not yet met. With that row, `overridden by: SOL-HW-MAIN-BOARD-SCHEMATIC-PROVEN.C8` plus the decision's accepted_by david and accepted_on 2026-10-29 closes the fuses (4.24, safety) and the K731 and K741 derating row. The K731 and K741 maximum switching voltage under PINV-1 (4.4) is an absolute-maximum exceedance that C8 does not reach.
- **(d) snubbers and RT301 not fitted (3.10, 3.12, 3.21): not valid.** Bring-up measurement is a plan, not an element that bounds the re-applied voltage or the inrush; open as 4.10, 4.12, 4.21.
- **(e) bought-part creepage under 10.0 mm (3.16): not valid.** SOL-HW-SEPARATION-BASIS-SIGNED.C3 requires the rating judged against the declared barrier, and an unsourced rating is absent; the owner's own reasons call for a fresh basis. Closes by the owner re-declaring and signing the basis with the part figures, or by parts that meet 10.0 mm. Open as 4.16. The through-hole option declined by the owner stands as a design choice, and the surface-mount MOC3052SVM keeps the family's 7 mm.

**Derating relaxations (2026-10-29).** DERATE-1 passes on the policy as it stands (three factors relaxed, each naming the Table 1 figure it departs from and the owner's reason). DERATE-2 is re-judged part by part on it: U301, K201 contact, U302, U401, U620, U621, U630 and U631 now pass; the arithmetic is in each row. U302's pass holds only on the tab copper (100 mm2 top, 2500 mm2 back pour, 56 degC/W) that the layout must provide. Still failing: fuses and valve relays at 253 V against 250 VAC, T701 Tj, TVS stand-offs, unsourced pulse ratings, crystal drive levels, unrated tabs and link, and twelve resistors with no power in the Rating field (4.23, 4.24). The tool's known limits (no exception mechanism, divider voltage misread; catalogue number none not accepted) are recorded as tool limits, not findings.

**Layout-dependent findings.** SOL-HW-MAIN-BOARD-PROVEN-AND-LAID-OUT.C4 to C8 carry placement and separation of entry parts, inner-layer routes, the basis on every layer, the layout checklist and the pre-order check. None carries the triac copper, regulator copper or crystal keep-clear figure that "Carried to the layout leaf" lists, and the triac copper cannot be computed from the record (WeEn gives Rth(j-a) typical only). A requirement the layout carries closes a finding only where it makes the stress what the finding needs; none does, so no layout-dependent finding closes by `overridden by:` those criteria. The one dependence that lets a verdict pass is U302, and it is stated in its row.

**Judgement flipped from rounds 1 to 3.** FAULT-1 rows for the 18 parts whose failure the other channel removes (latent) now pass: the item's first outcome is that the output is safe with the reason shown, and REQ-SAFETY-CHAIN-001.C8's first outcome is that heater power is removed; the item asks for detection only where the output is not left safe. Rounds 1 to 3 failed them for missing detection before a second fault. This is a re-reading of the item, stated openly so the designer and owner can overrule it.

| FAULT-1 | C202 | pass | netlist C202; circuit-proof.md A FAULT table (21 parts + C201), where the record states the effect and the outcome for each failure mode; a failed-short or failed-open mode of this part leaves the other channel's switch in the coil path, so the coil is unpowered and heater power is removed (the stack Q201/Q202 puts both switches in series with the coil, and each channel has its own coupling, bleed, node discharge and gate network): the item's first outcome (the output is safe, reason shown from the schematic) and REQ-SAFETY-CHAIN-001.C8's first outcome; the mode is latent (circuit-proof.md A: 'removed by the other channel, latent') and the test that shows it is the bring-up gate reading at TP201 and TP202; this re-judges rounds 1 to 3, which failed these parts for the missing detection: the item requires detection only where the output is not left safe, and a second fault is outside a single-fault item |  |

| 4.1 | PINV-1 | function | Continues 3.1. Round 4: the owner's acceptance (b) is now a graph decision (DEC-MAIN-BOARD-RESIDUAL-RISKS-ACCEPTED-BY-OWNER) but not an 'overridden by' form: none of the criteria the decision addresses admits a pin above its absolute maximum; see the judgements below. +5V in the cable position of JP301: D402 (SMF6.0A, VC 10.3 V at 19.4 A) lets a plug-in surge reach U201 and U791 (absolute maximum 7.0 V) and the coils of K201 (7.5 V short period) and K731 and K741 (8.5 V). The owner accepted it for bench use on 2026-10-29 (open-items.md (b)); that is a risk acceptance, not met, does not apply or overridden by, so it does not close the finding. Net +5V; Logic supply, Interlock, Valve drives, Gauge drive. | |

## Round 5

- **Schematic judged**: git commit d1f5c5bf028b52e0b0fea2434049665518327a81 (hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board/main-board.kicad_sch and its sheets; the only uncommitted file in the tree is the untracked main-board.kicad_prl).
- **Netlist**: `/Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/kicad-cli sch export netlist --output /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-david-repos-coffee/bbdbdd7d-2b79-4b88-9553-2a2bcf63188a/scratchpad/sch-review-r5/review.net hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board/main-board.kicad_sch` (KiCad 10.0.7; 445 parts, 280 nets, 18 sheets). Against round 4's netlist the nets and every pin are identical; the only differences are the Rating field and value of R609 to R615, R632, R641, R646, R672 and R677 ('1% 0603' now '1% 100mW 75V 0603') and the Value of TP206 (TP_COIL_HI now TP_+5V), TP671 (TP_WT1_INAP now TP_WT1_INA_P) and TP673 (TP_WT2_INAP now TP_WT2_INA_P). ### Judgements on what the owner and the records now offer

Step 5 allows a change, or a reason written `met:`, `does not apply:` or `overridden by:` a requirement the board serves or a catalogue item it must also meet; a safety finding closes by a reason only with a named person's `accepted_by` and `accepted_on`. The reviewer does not write Closed by; the texts below are what this round finds valid, for the designer to write.

**DEC-UNPUBLISHED-MAKER-FIGURES-CARRIED-TO-BRING-UP, with DEL-HW-BRING-UP.C15, as a closing form: valid in form, not yet usable on any finding.** The decision is the owner's (decided_by david) and DEL-HW-BRING-UP.C15 is a requirement the board's bring-up serves, so `overridden by: DEL-HW-BRING-UP.C15, with DEC-UNPUBLISHED-MAKER-FIGURES-CARRIED-TO-BRING-UP` is a form of the kind step 5 allows, where the figure is one the maker does not publish and a record carries it as a measurement with a stated limit. The decision states its own conditions: the limit is stated before the order, the measurement is a bring-up step, the part is graded on its published range, and it never reaches a barrier's rating or an absolute maximum the part's operation needs. Applying them to the board as committed: no board record names the decision or C15, and a search of circuit-proof.md, open-items.md, bring-up-provision.md and bring-up/*.yaml finds no row that states, for any of the HX711 absolute maximum, the Y402 C0 maximum, the ceramics' bias curves, the module inrush maximum and duration, a sensor's capacitance, the snubber resistors' pulse rating, the crystal drive level or the reverse-voltage rating of C302 and C792, a measurement with a limit. So each of those findings stays open for want of a record, and the decision's own text reopens a finding whose limit is not stated. The one existing carried measurement with a stated limit is the pump triac turn-off voltage at TP702 and TP712 against VDRM 600 V (circuit-proof.md section D, row 'Pump triac turn-off voltage'; bring-up-provision.md; the pump coil's turn-off voltage is in no record): finding 4.21 closes by that form. Two limits of the form, stated for the owner: it cannot close the HX711 finding while the +5V rail can leave the HX711's published 2.6 to 5.5 V range in the module's over-voltage trip (5.75 to 6.75 V) and in the cable position (10.3 V), because the decision grades on the published range and excludes a limit the operation needs to stay inside, and a destructive limit is not a bench measurement; and it does not reach the C412 and C413 floor, which is a published requirement of DS12110.

**Is `overridden by: SOL-HW-MAIN-BOARD-SCHEMATIC-PROVEN.C11` (amended) valid for the cable-position surge (4.1)? Not as it stands.** Round 4 said an amended criterion that states the plug-in surge the cable position must survive would be a form. C11 now accepts a transient up to D402's clamp level and states that it 'can damage only the relay-driver buffers, whose failure leaves the safety relay open', in a bench state with mains off. The form needs the criterion's statement to be true of the schematic. The +5V net reaches, in the round 5 netlist, U201 and U791 and also U630 and U631 (VSUP and AVDD; no absolute maximum stated by Avia), the sensor headers J520, J523, J524, J525, J570, J571, J630 and J635, the wall board through JP761, the gauge assembly through JP791, the coils of K201, K731 and K741 and Q822. The criterion names the buffers only. Closes when C11 (or decision (b)) names every part and off-board load the transient reaches and what becomes of each, or a limiter or series element keeps the transient under the parts' maxima.

**Is DEC-MAIN-BOARD-RESIDUAL-RISKS-ACCEPTED-BY-OWNER (f) valid for the USB data pins (4.2)? Not.** The decision addresses C11, and C11 requires ESD protection on the data lines, which D401 gives, and does not admit a residue above a pin's absolute maximum. The bounding element named, 'that arrangement and the shield network R403 and C419', is the clamp whose residue is the finding and a network on the shield, and neither bounds what happens at PA11 and PA12 or limits the damage to those pins. The ground (ST AN4879 recommends this arrangement) is a good ground and is a reason the exposure is small; it is an argument, not a form. The pin's pulse withstand is not a bench measurement, so the unpublished-figure decision does not fit. Closes by ST's stated pulse withstand, a series resistor or lower-residue clamp (a schematic change), or an amendment of C11 that states the accepted residue and the consequence it is limited to, as the amendment for 4.1 does for its transient.

**Decision (a) now names U201 oscillating, the Z201 and Z202 short above 1.10 H and POL_COIL_LO shorted to ground (4.15): valid.** Round 4 held that the same form that closed K201 welding, REQ-SAFETY-CHAIN-001.C8's third outcome with the series thermostats and the one-shot cutoff DEL-HW-BRING-UP.C4 requires before mains, closes these three once the decision names them. It does, and the person is named (decided_by david, 2026-10-29). The reason holds only while both bounding elements stand (the decision's own condition). The designer writes Closed by with accepted_by and accepted_on.

**250 VAC parts at 253 V (4.4, 4.23 for K731 and K741, 4.24 for F101, F701, F711, F731): not valid; this corrects round 4's proposed form.** Round 4 proposed `overridden by: SOL-HW-MAIN-BOARD-SCHEMATIC-PROVEN.C8` once a revisit row existed. The row exists, and C8 reads 'Every part is graded against the enclosure air temperature the constraints record holds ... where no catalogue part holds at that figure, the revisit of the figure is recorded in the constraints record': its figure is the enclosure air temperature, not the supply voltage, so C8 does not reach a voltage rating, and round 4's proposal was wrong to name it. The new row itself says that no catalogue search for a part at or above 253 V is recorded, so even C8's own pattern ('no catalogue part holds') is not shown. The decision's items (c) and (c2) carry the owner's acceptance by a named person and a ground (the machine's other factory parts are 250 V), but the bounds they name, 'the usual margin on 230 V and 240 V mains' and firmware monitoring that 'may warn', are neither elements independent of the failed part nor of the controller, and no requirement the decision addresses admits a rating below the span's top (C9 requires a departure from a judged figure to be resolved, not admitted). For PINV-1 the 250 VAC maximum switching voltage is also an absolute-maximum exceedance. Closes by a change (a fuse and a relay rated at or above 253 V), or by the maker's statement that the 250 VAC covers a 230 V + 10 % supply, or by a decision that names the element bounding a fuse or relay that fails to clear at the top of the span; for the four fuses, a safety finding, with accepted_by and accepted_on.

**Bought-part creepage (4.16): not valid; the re-signed basis does not change it.** Round 4 said re-declaring and signing the basis with the part figures would close it. The re-sign lists each bought part's ratings and which fall below the declared 10.0 mm creepage, 3.0 mm clearance and 4.0 kV, and keeps the declared figures; the signed text records an acceptance of a shortfall, which is not met, does not apply or overridden by, and the basis record carries it in a free-text field no check reads. The shortfalls stand (U601 8.0 mm, K201 and K731 and K741 over 8 mm, U701 and U711 7 mm), and the figures not stated by a maker (U301 creepage, clearance and impulse; U602 creepage, clearance and impulse; K201 clearance; K731 and K741 impulse) remain absent. Closes by parts that meet the declared figures, or by the owner declaring the figures the barriers are actually held to (for example the sealed and coated enclosure the owner describes, as a fresh basis with its pollution degree and the standard's rows) and the bought parts meeting those, with the unstated maker figures read.

**Surge above the pump triacs' 600 V (4.17, decision (g)): not valid as a closing form.** F4 now declares the surge (1.2/50 us and 8/20 us, 2 ohm, 1 kV assumed with 2 kV as envelope, from a freely available derivation) and computes the clamp (0.80 to 0.89 kV, an extrapolation above 50 A) against the parts behind it; the barrier parts with an impulse figure hold with margin, and T701 and T711 (VDRM 600 V) do not. Decision (g) is the owner's acceptance (named person, date, ground: no in-stock 800 V pair, stated as homework in the commit log and open-items.md and not re-verified here) and names as bounds the entry fuse, the branch fuses and the series safety relay. A fuse bounds overcurrent and not a triac that has turned on by overvoltage; the relay removes a failed pump 'when the controller stops commanding it', which is the controller noticing, and REQ-SAFETY-CHAIN-001.C8 excludes the controller from the bounding element; no requirement the decision addresses (C9 requires the clamp, and a departure from a judged figure to be resolved) admits the shortfall. SURGE-1 is safety severity, so it closes by a change or by a reason with a named person's acceptance. Closes by a triac and opto-triac pair at or above the clamp, a clamp that reaches 600 V, or an element independent of the controller that bounds a pump left running, named in a requirement or decision that admits it; and the surge level is an assumption the owner confirms. C101's and the other unshown impulse figures stay in the same finding.

**Touch current (4.19): the reason is not yet sound.** F5 names IEC 60335-1:2010 and a 0.75 mA limit for Class I portable appliances, quoted from a manufacturer's page that, by the record's own statement, does not show the Class II rows, and estimates 0.34 mA. The current the record is estimating is the current through a person touching the USB connector, whose secondary is not earthed, while 0.75 mA is the row of the table for a Class I appliance; the record does not show which row governs a current from an unearthed accessible part to a person, and the row that would is the one the cited page does not show. The limit for that route is therefore not sourced. Closes by the standard's rows for that route from a free source and the estimate compared with them, and, the finding being safety, by the owner's accepted_by and accepted_on (the class is marked assumed for the owner to confirm).

**ESD (4.18): the declaration does not close it.** The USB connector's level 4 is recorded and its residue is 4.2. The 'does not apply: inside the enclosure' of F6 is not borne out: the item applies to a conductor a person can reach 'in normal use or service', and the enclosure is opened in service. Closes by a declared level for service reach per connector class, with the clamping arithmetic or the barrier where the level exceeds the pins' maximum, and a clamp or accepted form on the seven key and knob lines.

**Emission limit (4.20, 4.22): a recorded reason is not one of the forms.** The owner's target is best effort and the limit rows of the governing standard are not held; the items require a named limit and its rows, and a reason that none is planned is not met, does not apply or overridden by a requirement. Closes by the limit rows (from a free source or the owner's copy) and the comparison, or by a requirement or decision in the graph that states the emission target and admits it.

**Judgement carried from round 4:** FAULT-1 rows for parts whose failure the other channel removes pass on the item's first outcome; the reviewer states again that this is a re-reading and the owner can overrule it.

**Known tool limits, recorded as such and not as findings:** the derating rule has no exception mechanism and misreads divider voltage (SOL-PRE-ORDER-CHECK-DERATED-VOLTAGE-ACROSS-DERIVED-NETS, SOL-PRE-ORDER-CHECK-PARTS-WITHOUT-CATALOGUE-NUMBER, authored, blocking the layout leaf); the parts rule does not yet accept catalogue number 'none' (round 4's finding 4.30 is that limit: it is carried as the tool limit and not raised again).

### Findings

| Finding | Raised by | Severity | What and where | Closed by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5.1 | PINV-1 | function | Continues 4.1. +5V in the cable position of JP301: D402 (SMF6.0A, VC 10.3 V at 19.4 A) lets a plug-in surge reach U201 and U791 (absolute maximum 7.0 V), the coils of K201 (7.5 V short period) and K731 and K741 (8.5 V), and the HX711 U630 and U631 (no absolute maximum), the sensor headers, the wall board and the gauge. Round 5: C11 is amended to accept the transient and says only the relay-driver buffers can be damaged; the netlist shows more parts on +5V than that, so the criterion is not a valid 'overridden by' ground as written. Net +5V; Logic supply, Interlock, Valve drives, Gauge drive, Load-cell amplifiers. Would close: C11 or decision (b) naming every part and load the transient reaches and the consequence for each, or a limiter or series element; the designer. | |
| 5.2 | PINV-1 | function | Continues 4.2. USB_DM and USB_DP: D401 lets 17 V through at 5 A to PA11 and PA12, limit 6 V (4 V with VDD absent), no pulse withstand stated (DS12110 Rev 11 Table 109). Round 5: decision (f) accepts it on AN4879's arrangement; not a valid form (no requirement admits it; the named bound is the clamp and the shield network). Controller sheet. Would close: ST's stated pulse withstand (a datasheet), a series resistor or lower-residue clamp (a drawing change), or C11 amended to state the accepted residue and what it is limited to (a record, the owner's). | |
| 5.3 | PINV-1 | function | Continues 4.3. HX711 U630 and U631: supply range 2.6 to 5.5 V stated, no absolute maximum or input levels (Avia V2.0); VSUP and AVDD are on +5V, which the module's trip (5.75 to 6.75 V) and the cable position (10.3 V) take above the published range. DEC-UNPUBLISHED-MAKER-FIGURES-CARRIED-TO-BRING-UP does not close it: no record carries a measurement and limit, and it grades on the published range and excludes a limit the operation needs. Nets with a pin on U630 or U631. Load-cell amplifiers sheet. Would close: HX711 supplies from a rail that cannot leave 5.5 V (a drawing change), or the maker's absolute maximum (a datasheet). | |
| 5.4 | PINV-1 | function | Continues 4.4. K731 and K741 state 250 VAC maximum switching voltage; /COFVALVE, /HOTVALVE and /Valve drives/VALVE_COM carry up to 253 V rms. The revisit row was added; SOL-HW-MAIN-BOARD-SCHEMATIC-PROVEN.C8 is a temperature criterion and does not reach it (corrects round 4's proposal). Valve drives sheet. Would close: a relay rated at or above 253 V (a drawing change), or the maker's statement that 250 VAC covers a 230 V + 10 % supply (a datasheet), or a decision naming a bounding element independent of the controller (the owner). | |
| 5.5 | PINV-2 | function | Continues 4.5. /POL_OUT from U401 PC7 (3.3 V domain) straight to U201 pin 2 (+5V domain): no unpowered tolerance stated, no series resistor; pin_limit lines U201 pin 2 and U401 pin 64. Interlock sheet. Would close: a series resistor in the net (a drawing change) or the maker's input current at VCC = 0 V (a datasheet). | |

Would close: a record row carrying the C0 or start-up measurement with its limit (2.58 pF), then `overridden by: DEL-HW-BRING-UP.C15 with the decision`; or a stated maximum (a datasheet). | |

## Round 6

- **Schematic judged**: git commit 502f317e63cfcb7da82631eddb67e01ce05c8365 (hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board/main-board.kicad_sch and its sheets; the only uncommitted files in the tree are the untracked main-board.kicad_prl and main-board.pretty/main-board.pretty). The rows below were judged on the schematic files of commit e16d375b48c5fa918606e679c834985334fe9e7a. Between that commit and the one stated, only commit cdc3533d changed a schematic file: two sheets (the D402 symbol on the Controller sheet and the U201 datasheet field on the Interlock sheet). The netlist is the same (282 nets, every pin identical) and the ERC reports zero violations at both; the later board-file commits change a via and footprint attributes and no schematic. Finding 6.27 describes D402 as the rows saw it at e16d375b, and cdc3533d already draws it with the cathode-marked symbol; no row was re-judged for that change, so the next round judges it.
- **Netlist**: the command as it was run:

```
/Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/kicad-cli sch export netlist --output review.net hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board/main-board.kicad_sch
```

- **Round kind**: full
- **Reviewer**: six reviewer groups, each a fresh agent session that did not draw, fix or close anything, judged by hand (the review kit could not run: the review folder is over the kit's size limit); every item of the checklist and every net, part and sheet has one author; the merge is the schematic caller's own checks and render (merge_schem.py).
- **Records read**: each record by path, with the separation basis record's `accepted_on` where the board declares mains:

### Judgements on what the owner and the records now offer

**This round does not close the review.** It raises 74 findings (10 of safety severity), none closed, and 25 of round 5's 29 findings stay open. The 10 safety-severity findings need a schematic change or a named person's `accepted_by` and `accepted_on`, never an agent's. A finding closed by a change also needs one further full round that judges the change. Step 5 of the method requires the closing round to be clean.

**The separation basis is unsigned at this commit.** `hardware/sunbeam-em7000/separation-basis.yaml` carries no `accepted_by` and no `accepted_on`, and its header says the record is unsigned; round 5 recorded it as signed (`accepted_on` 2026-10-23 in round 1). The barrier rows of this round rest on an unsigned record, so none of them can be taken as accepted until a named person signs it.

**Round 5 findings the round does close.** Closed by is written by the designer; the text below is what this round's rows support, in the form earlier rounds used. The rounds already recorded are not edited.

| TOUCH-1 | K201 | fail | Hongfa HF115F-Q 2024 Rev. 1.00: coil to contact capacitance not stated (no capacitance row on the sheet read); circuit-proof.md F5 takes an assumed 10 pF per barrier part, which is no maker figure; the limit: circuit-proof.md F5 first compared 0.75 mA (IEC 60335-1:2010 Class I portable, from Cosel secondary page, standard rows not held), open-items.md row M24 adopts 0.25 mA for the unearthed touchable USB shell and operator controls and says it is unverified against the standard; the board connects nothing from a mains conductor to protective earth (C101, C701 and C711 are line to neutral), so the protective-conductor current is zero from this board and only the touch current to the unearthed secondary arises | finding 6.36: the coil-to-contact leakage capacitance is absent from the maker's sheet, so the part's share of the touch current is unsourced. |

| 6.1 | PINV-1 | safety | Continues 5.4 and extends it. Parts rated 250 V on nets that carry up to 253 V rms (358 V peak): K731 and K741 (maximum switching voltage 250 VAC) on COFVALVE, HOTVALVE and VALVE_COM; F101 (LINE_IN, LINE_F), F701 (COFFPUMP, PUMP_C_MT2), F711 (STEAMPUMP, PUMP_S_MT2), F731 (VALVE_COM), type code 250 V, holders 250 VAC. The SETfuse sheet prints breaking capacity at 300 VAC (1500 A, plain type) which the designer may cite, but it states no rating of 253 V use and the 6 kA fault assumption is above it. Valve drives, Pump drives, Mains entry sheets. |  |
| 6.2 | PINV-1 | function | Pump drives, nets PUMP_C_MT2 and PUMP_S_MT2 (T701.2, T711.2): the voltage at turn-off on the inductive pump coil with no snubber and no clamp is in no record (716 V undamped against VDRM 600 V, a repetitive rating; no non-repetitive figure); the same exposure reaches U701 and U711 pin 6 through 400 ohm. |  |

The record divides by 660 ohm (both legs), but AIN1N sits at HGND, the same terminal as the shunt's neutral side (R105 pins 3 and 4, NT601), so the clamp current returns to HGND and flows through R607 alone: positive 8.5 mA at a 3.2 V clamp, negative 13.3 mA at a clamp at HGND-1.6 V, against the 10 mA continuous input current of 6.1; and 8.3.4 gives the undervoltage clamp only as "the reverse breakdown voltage" with no value, so the clamp level the arithmetic needs is not sourced. |  |

## Round 7

- **Schematic judged**: git commit af87877b621532b0f3a11a9ba05786e3b21cba9e (hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board/main-board.kicad_sch and its sheets; the working tree did not move during the round; the only uncommitted files in the tree are the untracked main-board.kicad_prl and main-board.pretty/main-board.pretty). Round 6 judged commit e16d375b; the netlist of this commit is the same as that round's (282 nets, every pin identical), and since then only two sheets changed: the D402 symbol on the Controller sheet and the U201 datasheet field on the Interlock sheet.
- **Netlist**: the command as it was run:

```
/Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/kicad-cli sch export netlist --output review.net hardware/sunbeam-em7000/main-board/main-board.kicad_sch
```

- **Pre-order check**: the report is the real `task check:round` hw:verify section from the same board design (the board file is unchanged since commit 1f9f8357): check-report.txt, cut from the round.log of that gate run, which ended with hw:verify at exit status 201; for main-board it reports 1070 violations. The duplicate check that was started at preparation was stopped.

- **Reviewer**: six reviewer groups plus a datasheet reader, each a fresh agent session that did not draw, fix or close anything, judged by hand (the review kit refused to plan the round: the shared documents are 6,012,293 tokens against its 700,000-token budget); every item of the checklist and every net, part and sheet has one author; the merge is the schematic caller's own checks and render (merge_schem.py).

### Judgements on what the owner and the records now offer

**This round does not close the review.** It raises 84 findings (12 of safety severity), none closed (Closed by is the designer's to write). Of the 74 findings of round 6, 70 continue and 4 (6.5, 6.27, 6.30, 6.47) are closed by this round's rows; 7 findings are new in this form (see below). Of the 12 safety-severity findings, 3 are covered by an owner acceptance as the reviewer who raised them read it, 4 are covered in part and 5 are not covered by any acceptance. A safety finding closes only by a change to the schematic or a named person's `accepted_by` and `accepted_on`, never an agent's; and a finding closed by a change needs one further full round that judges the change. Step 5 of the method requires the closing round to be clean, and this round is not.

**What is signed.** `hardware/sunbeam-em7000/separation-basis.yaml` carries `accepted_by` (David Baker (owner), entered by Claude on the owner's written instruction) and `accepted_on` 2026-11-05, and each of its 33 `accepted_exceptions` entries carries its own; round 6's statement that the barrier rows rest on an unsigned record no longer applies. `derating-policy.yaml` carries 10 `accepted_exceptions` entries (F101, F701, F711, F731, K731, K741, R102, R104, R706, R716), each signed the same way on 2026-11-05. A signature makes an exception the owner's; it does not make a part meet its rating. The reviewers judged every barrier part against the figures the record gives, and two gaps stand: the basis header says the bought-part creepage exceptions are held in `accepted_exceptions`, which has no entry for K201, K731, K741, U601, U602, U701 or U711, and acceptance (e) does not name U301, which `barrier_types` still calls owner-accepted (finding 7.35); and circuit-verdicts.md row U301 says the basis lists no such barrier, where the signed basis lists a supply-module barrier.

**What DEC-MAIN-BOARD-RESIDUAL-RISKS-ACCEPTED-BY-OWNER (version 17) covers, acceptance by acceptance, as this round's reviewers applied it.** The rule they applied: an acceptance covers a finding only where it names that exact risk and its bounding element and the finding rests on the ground the acceptance states. The decision is a graph decision, not a signature field; (i) and (n) are stated in it as the owner's, and (n), (o), (p) as confirmed on 2026-11-06.

| INDEP-1 | /Interlock/POL_BUF | pass | netlist C202.1, C204.1, TP204.1, U201.4; netlist trace of the element (U201, R201 to R207, C201 to C205, D201 to D206, Q201, Q202, Z201, Z202, K201, TP201, TP202, TP204, TP205, TP206): every net of it is local to the Interlock sheet except +5V, GND, LINE, LINE1 and POL_OUT, and the only net that reaches the controller is /POL_OUT (U401 pin 64, PC7, a push-pull GPIO per controller-pin-table.md and pin-allocation.yaml channel pol_out), which is the proof-of-life signal itself; CLOCK: none of its nets reaches HSE_IN, HSE_OUT, LSE_IN, LSE_OUT, a timer output or any clock net, and its time base is the passive R203 x C203 and R204 x C205 (5.6 Mohm and 4.7 nF, with R205 and R206 100 kohm) that no controller part feeds; with the controller clock stopped POL_OUT gives no edge, both gates decay in 56.5 ms (circuit-proof.md A Hold-off table, output held low or held high) and the coil releases; RESET: no net of the element is NRST (netlist NRST pins C418.1, J401.10, SW401.1, TP404.1, U401.14, U402.2) or a reset output; with the controller in reset PC7 is a floating input (controller-pin-table.md row 64) and R201 and R202 (50 kohm) hold POL_IN low, no edge, removal in 56.5 ms; SUPPLY: the element takes +5V (U201.5, K201.A1) and the controller takes +3V3 from U302 off the same +5V (netlist U302.1 on +5V, U302.3 to JP302 to +3V3 pins U401.100, 11, 27, 50, 75, U402.3), so the source is shared; +5V collapse unpowers the coil and every edge source together, and a +3V3 sag leaves POL_OUT low or floating with the pull-downs holding the input low, so both fail in the direction that removes power (circuit-proof.md A Hold-off table rows controller in reset, 3V3 absent with 5V present, 5V absent); datasheet: Nexperia 74AHC1G17; 74AHCT1G17 Rev. 5 (14 March 2025) (ds/rev5.txt) Table 7 II 2.0 uA max at VI 5.5 V with VCC 0 to 5.5 V, Table 8 VT- min 0.5 V; the circuit-proof.md 'Interlock residual: a toggling timer' row records that firmware, not hardware, keeps a timer from toggling PC7 after the loop stops (the proof-of-life signal is the one signal the item allows) |  |
